title: User Interaction vs. Programmatic Event Ordering

drivingSurface.pointer: MouseEvent('click', {bubbles, composed}) dispatched on rendered [part="option"] elements of the open listbox
drivingSurface.keyboard: KeyboardEvent('keydown') dispatched on [part="input"] (Enter/ArrowDown only; interaction-triggered select events, not full APG navigation)
drivingSurface.optionRemove: .click() on a SelectOption's shadow-root [part="chip-remove"] remove button

observationSurface.events: CustomEvent.detail for select / change / clear / remove
observationSurface.callbacks: onSelect / onChange / onClear registered via updateConfig({callbacks})

verifiedSequences.option_activation: select -> change -> onChange -> onSelect (change emitted BEFORE onSelect; single primary path)
verifiedSequences.select_absent_on_programmatic: setSelectedValues() emits change -> onChange only (no select/onSelect)
verifiedSequences.programmatic_clear: clear() emits change -> onChange only (no clear/onClear)
verifiedSequences.chip_or_option_removal: change -> onChange -> remove (no select, onSelect not invoked)
verifiedSequences.clear_control_empty: button disabled; click is a no-op; NO event/callback

payloads.select: { item, index, value, label, selected, multi } (exact key set asserted; index = source registry index; selected reflects post-dispatch engine state; multi = mode==='multi')
payloads.change: { selectedItems, selectedValues, selectedIndices } (agrees with public getters; multi values in selection-insertion order, e.g. selecting c then a => ['c','a'], indices [2,0])
payloads.remove: { item, index } (index = source registry index; verified 0 and 2)

characterizedAreas.T4-01_pointer: single select/replace, multi accumulation; select->change->onChange->onSelect per activation
characterizedAreas.T4-02_keyboard: Enter opens then Enter selects active option (ArrowDown establishes active); keyboard deselect via reopen+Enter with allowDeselect; payload shape identical to pointer
characterizedAreas.T4-03_flags: single selected=true on select, selected=false on allowDeselect toggle; multi selected toggles true/false/true; multi flag true in multi mode, false in single
characterizedAreas.T4-04_payloads: exact select key set {item,index,value,label,selected,multi}; change agrees with getters; multi insertion order; onSelect gets select.detail; onChange gets (items,values); change follows each select incl. deselect empty
characterizedAreas.T4-05_ordering: select->change->onChange->onSelect is stable; events bubble (composed) to light-DOM ancestor
characterizedAreas.T4-06_clear: clear-control change->onChange->clear->onClear and empties (non-required); empty activation disabled/no-event; selection-only (clearSearch=false); required preserves selection yet clearedSelection=true (DEVIATION-10)
characterizedAreas.T4-07_remove: chip removal and option-level removal both change->onChange->remove, no select; remove.detail index = source registry index; change reflects post-removal selection
characterizedAreas.T4-08_rejected_noop: disabled(blocked) = no event no state; disabled(selectable) = full select sequence; maxSelections reject = no event no state; single re-select allowDeselect=false = NO state change BUT events fire; allowDeselect=true = deselect with events
characterizedAreas.T4-09_prog_vs_interaction: programmatic setSelectedValues/clear = change->onChange only; interaction adds select/remove/clear layers as above
